title: UX Designer Deep‑Dive Roadmap
summary: A step‑by‑step plan to master research, architecture, and visual design while building a professional portfolio. Focuses on best practices, larger projects, and job‑ready habits.

phases.title: Foundations
phases.summary: Build a solid base in UX theory and essential tools.

milestones.title: Core UX Concepts
milestones.outcome: Can explain the UX design process and its phases.

tasks.title: Read UX Design Basics
tasks.description: Study the introductory chapters of the free UX Design Guide on the Nielsen Norman Group site.

tasks.title: Watch Design Thinking Video
tasks.description: View the 20‑minute Design Thinking overview on the Interaction Design Foundation YouTube channel.

tasks.title: Summarize Key Steps
tasks.description: Write a one‑page summary of the UX process from discovery to delivery.

tasks.title: Create Process Diagram
tasks.description: Sketch a flow diagram of the UX stages in Figma using basic shapes.

milestones.title: Figma Fundamentals
milestones.outcome: Can navigate Figma, create frames, and use components.

tasks.title: Complete Figma Intro Course
tasks.description: Finish the free Figma Basics tutorial on the official Figma Learn site.

tasks.title: Set Up Design File
tasks.description: Create a new Figma file, add pages, and organize layers for a mock project.

tasks.title: Build Component Library
tasks.description: Design 5 reusable UI components (button, input, card, nav, icon) and turn them into components.

tasks.title: Practice Auto‑Layout
tasks.description: Recreate a simple login form using Auto‑Layout to understand constraints.

tasks.title: Share for Feedback
tasks.description: Invite a peer to view the file and request a quick design critique.

phases.title: Core Skills
phases.summary: Develop research, architecture, and prototyping abilities.

milestones.title: User Research Methods
milestones.outcome: Can plan and conduct a basic user interview and synthesize findings.

tasks.title: Read Interview Guide
tasks.description: Study the free interview guide on the UX Research Collective blog.

tasks.title: Draft Interview Script
tasks.description: Write a 5‑question script targeting a specific user problem.

tasks.title: Recruit 3 Participants
tasks.description: Use social media or a university forum to recruit three participants for a 30‑minute interview.

tasks.title: Conduct Mock Interview
tasks.description: Run a 30‑minute interview with a friend acting as a user, record notes.

tasks.title: Create Affinity Map
tasks.description: Group interview insights into themes on a Miro board (free version).

milestones.title: Information Architecture
milestones.outcome: Can organize content into clear navigation structures and site maps.

tasks.title: Read IA Basics
tasks.description: Read the IA chapter on the free UX Design Handbook (UXPin).

tasks.title: Audit Existing App
tasks.description: Choose an app you use daily and map its current navigation hierarchy.

tasks.title: Create Card Sort
tasks.description: Design a 20‑item open card‑sort using OptimalSort free trial.

tasks.title: Build Site Map
tasks.description: Translate card‑sort results into a hierarchical site map in Figma.

tasks.title: Validate with Peer
tasks.description: Share the site map with a fellow designer for quick critique.

phases.title: Proof of Work
phases.summary: Apply skills to real‑world portfolio projects.

milestones.title: App Redesign Case Study
milestones.outcome: Portfolio includes a full redesign narrative with research, IA, and UI.

tasks.title: Select Target App
tasks.description: Pick an app you use frequently that has usability issues.

tasks.title: Conduct 5‑Minute Survey
tasks.description: Create a short Google Form and collect 10 responses about pain points.

tasks.title: Define Personas
tasks.description: Synthesize survey data into two primary user personas in Figma.

tasks.title: Sketch Wireflows
tasks.description: Draw low‑fidelity wireflows for the main user journey.

tasks.title: Prototype Key Screens
tasks.description: Create a high‑fidelity prototype of the onboarding flow in Figma.

milestones.title: Usability Study Project
milestones.outcome: Portfolio shows a documented usability test with findings and recommendations.

tasks.title: Recruit 5 Participants
tasks.description: Post a brief recruitment request on Reddit’s r/UserTesting community.

tasks.title: Prepare Test Script
tasks.description: Write a 6‑step task script focusing on core app functions.

tasks.title: Run Remote Tests
tasks.description: Conduct 5 remote moderated tests using Zoom, record screen and audio.

tasks.title: Analyze Results
tasks.description: Identify usability issues and rate severity in a spreadsheet.

tasks.title: Write Study Report
tasks.description: Compose a concise report with screenshots, findings, and design recommendations.

phases.title: Getting Ready
phases.summary: Refine advanced practices, professional habits, and job search readiness.

milestones.title: Design Critique Mastery
milestones.outcome: Can give and receive constructive feedback effectively.

tasks.title: Read Critique Guidelines
tasks.description: Study the free ‘Design Critique’ article on Smashing Magazine.

tasks.title: Join Design Critique Group
tasks.description: Participate in a weekly critique session on a public Discord design channel.

tasks.title: Give Structured Feedback
tasks.description: Provide a 5‑minute verbal critique for a peer’s portfolio piece using the “I like, I wish, What if” format.

tasks.title: Reflect on Feedback Received
tasks.description: Write a short reflection on how the feedback will change your work.

tasks.title: Document Feedback Loop
tasks.description: Add a feedback‑log section to your portfolio case studies.

milestones.title: Advanced Wireframing & Prototyping
milestones.outcome: Can create detailed, interactive wireframes that communicate design intent.

tasks.title: Study Mid‑Fidelity Wireframes
tasks.description: Read the free article on mid‑fidelity wireframing on UX Collective.

tasks.title: Create Mid‑Fi Wireframe Set
tasks.description: Design a set of 8 mid‑fidelity screens for a new feature in Figma.

tasks.title: Add Interactive Components
tasks.description: Use Figma’s prototyping tools to link screens with transitions and overlays.

tasks.title: Test Prototype with Peer
tasks.description: Conduct a 15‑minute usability walk‑through with a colleague and note observations.

tasks.title: Iterate Based on Feedback
tasks.description: Refine the wireframes and interactions according to the peer notes.

milestones.title: Job‑Ready Portfolio & Interview Prep
milestones.outcome: Has a polished portfolio and can articulate design decisions in interviews.

tasks.title: Curate Portfolio Pieces
tasks.description: Select three strongest projects, write case study narratives, and upload to a Behance or personal site.

tasks.title: Create One‑Pager Resume
tasks.description: Design a concise UX resume in Figma highlighting key skills and metrics.

tasks.title: Practice STAR Stories
tasks.description: Write three STAR‑formatted answers for common UX interview questions.

tasks.title: Mock Interview Session
tasks.description: Schedule a 45‑minute mock interview with a senior designer via LinkedIn.

tasks.title: Reflect on Interview Feedback
tasks.description: Note strengths and improvement areas, then update portfolio accordingly.
